t: Letters Regarding A Gang Of Armed Bandits

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
C. I. D. REGISTER
No. I. O. D. 1213.
Date...29...4...30.

April 23, 30.

Sir,

I have to acknowledge receipt
of your letter, No. 38, dated April 26,
1930, regarding a gang of armed bandits,
and to inform you that the matter is
receiving attention.

I am, Sir,
Your Obedient Servant,

Deputy Commissioner of Police
(Crime & Special Branches.

Mr. Chu Yao Chun, 池耀宗
Inspector i/c 1st District
of the Kiangsu Water Public Safety Bureau.

1.0. D. 1213.
SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
COMMISSIONER'S OFFICE.
Translation of a letter No. 38 from the 1st District of the Kiangsu Water
Public Safety Bureau.
April 26, 1930.
Commissioner of Police,
British Police Force,
Shanghai.
Sir,
I have to inform you that on the 23rd of the
armed
present month a large gang of/bandits entered Chun
Ku Tseng, Tsingpo, surrounded the Public Safety
Bureau and the Volunteer Corps, disarmed them,
shot and killed some policemen, ransacked the shops
and kidnapped two men named Wu Chi-wan and Chu Chi-
chow. The gang then proceeded westward and ransacked
Chao Tung Jao on their way. Strict steps should
therefore be adopted to effect the arrest of the
members of the gang. It is feared that the bandits
may flee to and take refuge in Shanghai. Special
attention should therefore be paid to suspicious
characters in lodging houses. Whilst instructing
our detectives to make confidential enquiries and to
report to your Station for assistance when required
I have to write this to request you to render assistance
to our men when necessary.
ack
p.t.
28/4
Chu Chun-yao,
Inspector i/c District.

I. O. D. 1213。
上海公共租界工部局警务处。
警务长办公室。
江苏省水上公安局第一区第38号来函译文。
1930年4月26日。

上海
英国警察部队
警务长
先生：

兹告知，本月23日，一大伙武装匪徒进入青浦重固镇，包围了公安局及志愿队，解除其武装，枪杀数名警察，洗劫商店，并绑架了两名分别名为吴启万（Wu Chi-wan）和朱启周（Chu Chi-chow）的男子。该伙匪徒随后向西行进，途中洗劫了赵屯桥（Chao Tung Jao）。因此，应采取严厉措施以逮捕该伙成员。唯恐匪徒逃往上海并藏匿于此。因此，应对旅馆中的可疑人物予以特别注意。在指令我方侦探进行秘密调查并在需要时向贵局报告以求协助的同时，特致此函，请求在必要时为我方人员提供协助。

知悉
下转
4月28日

朱春耀（Chu Chun-yao），
区督察长
